releaseNotes:
Receipts that read "PARTIALLY PAID" against money paid in full are now repaired too.

4.8.8 repaired receipts that had been credited nothing at all. This version also repairs the ones credited only part of their charge - the receipt showing "Amount received 1,200, Settled so far 200" where the 200 came from a later payment and the receipt's own 1,200 was never credited to it.

As before it takes a backup first, records what it did, and can be undone. Only a receipt's STATUS changes: no amount is altered, and no receipt is added or removed. A genuine part-payment is left exactly as it is, and so is a receipt whose money really did pay an older debt.
